## VNB Podcast Episode: College Spending Tips


Virginia National Bank (VNB) is excited to announce the launch of our new podcast, **“Virginia National Bank: My Forever Bank”** ! The new podcast show features interviews with our financial experts and local community partners.


In our new episode, VNB’s Meghan Crider, President, Educational Programs, discusses College Spending Tips with Sherry Taylor, Podcast host & producer, Marketing.


Students may be starting college for the first time and there are many factors to consider when planning for a successful school year, financially speaking. Ms. Crider provides several tips to families on preparing for student loan debt, taking accountability, and how to prepare for life after graduation.


*Listen to the interview below and follow VNB's **“My Forever Bank”** podcast show wherever you listen to podcasts.*
